All errors are of two kinds: every move and action "lacks verb, outputs" (records use singular `output:` and no `verb:`), and every inputs entry "is not a named slot (slot, type, role, cardinality)". criteria.evidence: Frames and sources.md are frozen (2026-08-13), and the authorities are real works: OMB 2006, Groves 2009, Grimmer & Stewart 2013, Moreo & Sebastiani 2019, FPP3, Gneiting & Raftery 2007, Grimm 2020 ODD, Railsback & Grimm 2019, Sargent 2013, JRC 2020. P07 does state its construct-validity boundary explicitly (sources.md 'Construct-validity boundary' paragraph; frame source_scope_caution). The criterion still fails, for four reasons. P09's only experiment-design authority beyond ODD is R&G 2019 ch. 8 'Emergence', whose experiment section, §8.3 'Simulation Experiments and BehaviorSpace' (pp. 105-111, checked against the publisher's table of contents), is a tutorial for a NetLogo tool. That trips the implementation-only negative control. P06 anchors OMB standards that do not exist (4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 5.3; the official PDF lists 4.1, 5.1, 5.2, 6.1 and 7.1-7.4). P08 anchors FPP3 §3.5 for distributional forecasts, but §3.5 is 'Methods used by official statistics agencies' and the right section is §5.5 (checked on otexts.com). P07's prevalence authority is a two-page SIGIR item (pp. 1415-1416).

All four methods have three levels, and each refuses causal use in its uncertainty file (u05 in each) and, for P06, P07 and P09, through a prohibited_transition (p06.c14, p07.c12, p09.c16/c17). The criterion fails anyway. The records are incomplete: there is no verb, no typed output slots, and the inputs are bare strings. The topology is not typed per §5.8: shapes are uncontrolled, there are no required/optional/prohibited cycles, conditional failure loops are mislabelled as required, and there are no refusal terminals. Many inputs have no producing record or binding. Uncertainty items use the categories inexactly and never say which records they gate. P09's conclude output lists 'observed' among its information origins without separating it from simulated content.
